payload.body: A human can pull up every decision made across ALL maps in one ledger view — e.g. 'nahel decisions --since 7d --by agent' — each line the decision one-liner with its ticket, map, deciding actor, and whether it was grilled cross-agent, delegated (DD6 chain), or human-made; zoom via ticket show / recall. Closes the review gap that today decisions are per-map (plan briefing, map show) with no store-wide 'what did agents decide while I was away' digest. Continues planning-partner — set --predecessor once that node is released. Fold-in candidate: a usage hint in recall help that quoted strings are exact-phrase searches.
